description.en: concrete pump integral piston φ250 is restated under Electromagnetic induction. A φ250 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ250 as its piston.

h1.en: The printed concrete pump integral piston φ250 line, ordered as Electromagnetic induction orders its page
h1.zh: 已印的concrete pump integral piston φ250，按《Electromagnetic induction》的页面次序来写

directAnswer.en: Electromagnetic induction is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump integral piston φ250 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. A φ250 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ250 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: 《Electromagnetic induction》是百科页。concrete pump integral piston φ250仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 φ250 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ250 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: “History” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ250. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The split-piston page also lists φ250, with its own material row and a set as the unit. Same outer diameter does not merge the two parts. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ250, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “历史”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ250。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。分体活塞页也有 φ250，那边有自己的材料行，单位是套。外径相同也不会把两件配件并成一件。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ250 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Theory” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. A φ250 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ250 as its piston. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “理论”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 φ250 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ250 写成自己的活塞。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Applications”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“用途”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: “Eddy currents” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 整体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. Unprinted cells stay unprinted. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electromagnetic_induction
body.zh: “来源章节：Eddy currents”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明整体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 没有印出的格子保持不印。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electromagnetic_induction

question.en: Why is Electromagnetic induction not a source of extra ratings for concrete pump integral piston φ250?
question.zh: 为什么《Electromagnetic induction》不能给concrete pump integral piston φ250增加额定值？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
